rationale: Both screen with corpus F@g regression ratios (0.3/0.15). A takes topic coefficient from corpus topic dummies, uses single-edit hand pairs with amplification calibration, and selects latents by grid search with a topic-kept constraint, without ablation. B takes the topic coefficient from sample-logit label regression, uses 2x2 factorials, a fixed 11/5 split with per-latent topic cap, and ablation checks.

A ranks latents by gradient x corpus-regression shift with per-latent topic cap; cues come from logit-space dependence ratio plus 2x2 factorial true logits. B builds a seeded template generator for multi-seed minimal-pair screens of all properties and decides cues by absolute latent effect threshold. It ranks latents from generated-pair deltas under a cumulative topic cap and checks regexes on generated notes.
